task.description: Implement EXT-02 backend behavior according to src/design/ext-02-webhook-event-dispatch.md. Add PLATFORM_ADMIN-protected webhook subscription APIs: POST/GET/DELETE /webhooks/subscriptions with storage for target_url, event_types, optional secret, status, and retry metadata. Implement event fan-out dispatch for instance started/completed/errored and task activated/completed with independent per-subscription delivery state. Deliver outbound HTTP POST payloads with required headers, including optional X-BPM-Signature HMAC-SHA256 over request body when secret is configured. Enforce at-least-once delivery with exponential backoff retries up to 5 attempts for non-2xx/timeouts. On 5 consecutive failures, pause subscription and trigger OBS-06 alert emission. Ensure create/delete operations emit OBS-03 audit records. Treat any 2xx response as success regardless of body format. Keep SQL security guarantees (prepared statements only), avoid catch unreachable on realistic failures, and preserve no-I/O rule in src/engine/transition.zig.
acceptance_criteria: No error-set propagation gaps remain (zig build stderr has no error-set warnings)
EXT-02 acceptance criteria and edge cases are implemented as designed

result.summary: Implemented EXT-02 webhook backend: added PLATFORM_ADMIN-protected POST/GET/DELETE subscription handlers, subscription persistence with OBS-03 create/delete audit writes, dispatch fan-out queueing and due-delivery processing with optional HMAC signature header, exponential retry/backoff with pause-on-exhaustion, OBS-06 paused-subscription alert emission integration, and schema migration for retry metadata/state fields.
